Results.ReviewText:
This is a very solid little grill, probably one of the best made small portable gas grills on the market. I've cooked some great wings, chicken breasts, burgers, and veggies on it. Unfortunately, the low range isn't very low, especially when ambient temperatures get up above 80F, 90F, 100F. Recently, with the lid closed on low, I measured temps from 550F-650F at 1" above the cooking surface in a variety of places with my ThermaQ. That's 100F-200F above the ~450F-475F indicated on the lid thermometer. I contacted support and they sent out a new regulator and valve assembly, but that made no difference.

So, you can probably forget any kind of low and slow cooking on this thing, but it works well at higher temperatures. I need to rig up some type of block or adjustment that will hold the lid cracked open a set amount. That'll be the only way to achieve lid-"closed" cooking temperatures in the 350F-400F range or lower. Or maybe an adjustable vent on the top of the lid would help cool things down on low.

Anyway, the too-hot performance on low is the only thing keeping this from getting 5 stars and excellent from me.
Results.Title: Great little grill overall, but bad low range

Results.ReviewText: I have been reviewing small grills for my wife and me for some time and, because of my good past experience with Weber, they were at the top of my list. Now that we've used it the first few times, I'm very pleased.  It easily grills enough steaks and burgers for six with room left over.  The grilling time recommended in the instructions is spot on for medium-rare.  It's easy to clean and is small and light enough to move into our garage when not in use, freeing space on our small patio.  I would definitely buy this grill again.

Results.ReviewText: After deliberating quite a while between this and a competitor's patio model I bought this.  So far so good, I don't regret it at all and I expect years of great grilling!  I bought this based on several factors: personal recommendation from those I know, the parts warranty exceeds other manufacturers, it's well made, and it's portable. Here in Michigan, my family and I grill at about 1-2 times per week almost year round.  I've grilled quite a few times with it, even took it to the beach at a state park. I'm still getting used to how efficient it is.  I've over cooked some meat a couple times but it was still juicy despite being cooked past my normal preference because of searing the meat.  Even with the lid closed and on the lowest setting it still reaches at or above 300 so it's difficult to cook something "low and slow" and indirect because of the unit only having one burner--Could this also be a regulator issue? My neighbor has done some indirect cooking by placing the food in a container that was slightly elevated and off the cooking grate.  I might try that.  I bought the adapter hose to hook up to the large propane tank I have left from getting rid of the old grill. That works great.  I bought a 16" x 30" two shelf steel tool cart for from a local tool and freight store because the Weber Q 1200 cart cannot accommodate full size propane tanks.  I wish all of the Weber Q carts could accommodate any Weber Q.  I've called customer service a couple times just for tips and tricks and they've been super helpful.  Maybe in the future they'll make the colored lids available for all Weber Q models....it would be great to have the 2 burner model some day in a different color.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are sorry to hear about the issue getting your propane bottle attached. The easiest way to attach the propane bottle is to set it against the regulator connection and turn it counterclockwise until it sets into the threads. Results.ReviewText: I’ve had my grill for a few months now and I can’t think of a single negative thing to say about it. I originally purchased it for quick small meals while we are outside at the pool, instead of having to wait for my husband’s green egg to get to the right temp and everything. My husband laughed and said I wouldn’t stick with it. Long story short, we use this little Weber more than the egg now! Not only is it great for throwing on some quick burgers or hot dogs while at the pool, it’s also fantastic for steaks, chicken, sausage, and ribs. We’ve also grilled corn on the cob and asparagus on it. Lighting it is a breeze since you only have to press a button. Clean-up is super easy since the grates come out. I typically spray them with nonstick spray the same as I do when I cook inside on the stove, and I haven’t had an issue with anything sticking. The drip pan underneath is awesome since they make the disposable pans. I just clean out the main pan and put it in there. The grill isn’t heavy, and I look forward to taking it camping someday. I’m officially hooked on grilling now, thanks to my little blue Weber Q1200!

I don’t move it around though I have it on a moving cart. It’s connect to a large propane tank. I do put it inside when we leave. When my larger bbq died this year, I easily decided to buy another one of these. again, it’s PERFECT! as my primary bbq, again attached to a large propane tank and in stationary position during the bbq season.
Results.Title: Perfect!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for taking the time to provide your feedback! While we do not have a conversion kit to natural gas, we do have an adapter hose so the grill can be used with a standard 20 lb propane tank. The adapter hose for your model can be found here: http://Wbr.gr/QAdapterHose Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: I love my little BBQ but sadly must go through multitudes of little propane bottles since it can't be converted for natural gas. I use it every night for dinner so a canister doesn't even last a week. They're not expensive but it's a hassle and a waste. Plus I have to discard the bottles at a hazardous waste center. I wanted something small but regret buying it now for that reason alone. Also igniter went out on me and although Weber sent me a free replacement, the "simple" install instructions, although not complicated, are anything but simple as they require a complete dismantle and reassembly.
Results.Title: Love the size... if only

Results.ReviewText: Now that the kids are grown and gone, we downsized from a big house to a patio home. Everything that was 'big home' got sold off and that included the big BBQ grill. But being from Texas we HAD to keep grillin'. It's in our DNA! So the "Q 1200" was the obvious choice. No, we don't go camping so our Q stay put on it's nifty stand with a cover. Perfect for us. Perfect for out situation and no compromise to excellent Weber quality we have long enjoyed.
Results.Title: Just perfect!

Results.ReviewText: I love everything about this little grill and would recommend it to anyone.  I’d cook everything on this if I could .
Results.Title: This thing is awesome.

Results.ReviewText: Love it and I’m so happy with this little grill. We have always had Weber grill but now that I’m a widow this grill is perfect for me. I use it all the time.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Very compact, easy to use, with great results. Is great at home and travels well.  Well built, great value for the price.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: As a Nebraska Husker, I just had to buy this. Weber is a top of the line BBQ manufacturer so I couldn't lose. We went camping for 4 days and my Weber never let me down, I'm buying some accessories for it like a grill and other needed items and that should even make the experience even better.
Results.Title: Chillin' n Grillin'

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with it.  I am 74 years old and it is so easy to handle.
Results.Title: Perfect size.

Results.ReviewText: I have had the larger version on my deck for 10 years. All I use. When I saw this size on sale had to have it for the camper. Best portable grill there is.
Results.Title: Camper Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill works great! I love how the cart folds and you can bring it anywhere!
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is awesome. I already had the 3200 the bigger version of this at home. I bought this to take camping. It works just as well if not better then the bigger one. Heat distribution is even and easy to control. Can cook a great steak. Can’t go wrong. The only thing I have seen that isn’t perfect is it is a little tricky to get the lp can screwed into the grill because it is tucked up under close to the legs. But definitely doable.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a month and I am very happy because of the quality and customer service
Results.Title: Great features

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We are sorry to hear about the igniter button on your grill! We have reached out via email to help get the igniter replaced and to offer some advice for grilling at lower temperatures on your Q 1200. Thanks!

Results.ReviewText: I received this as a gift from my son. It was delivered quickly and easy to assemble. The first few times I used it, per the instructions, I expected it to run hot and it did...but I've never managed to actually control the temp with the gauge, it always is hot. I was a caterer for many years, never had that issue with a gas grill before. But the real problem is that the button to ignite the grill came off and when I finally found it, it doesn't go back into place and I cannot light the grill. I'm going to mess with it some this weekend as I have guests coming on Memorial Day but I'm guessing we won't be having grilled chicken for our holiday dinner. My son lives out of town, he said he'd look at it when he comes and see about returning it. I'm really disappointed, it seemed the perfect answer for small grill for a single person to use frequently. But it does look nice sitting there in its lovely cover....
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: We purchased the Q1200 Weber grill to take in our motor home.  We needed a grill that wouldn’t take up a lot of room. The grill is perfect in size. The sides fold inside the grill itself which makes it perfect. It was fantastic to have a choice of color.
Results.Title: Right size!

Results.ReviewText: Love how this grill works!  It totally does the cooking best as I've had grills before, but none like this Weber.   Can't do any better when it comes to cooking outdoors and enjoying your meal.
Results.Title: best gas grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: My 9 year old son expressed an interest in grilling and was doing OK on our old spirit.  I decided to get this so that he could work a little more easily and possibly with more even heat and a more reliable thermometer.  This grill has completely lived up the the reviews.  We’ve used it regularly since purchase.  The heat seems very evenly distributed, the drip pan is in a great spot so that my dogs dont try to get into it.  With the lid down, there is awesome heat retention.  We have even used an iron skillet on the grill to make taco filling!  The grates, while not iron, are durable and easily cleaned.  With a stand and cover and the conversion kit, this grill is plenty effective as a stand alone cooking platform on a back porch or patio but still offers the convenience of being portable if necessary with a small propane bottle.  One of my favorite features is the fold in side boards...they are sturdy enough when grilling and then fold in once the grill cools for a small profile on a smaller porch.
Results.Title: Every bit the grill as our old Spirit

Results.ReviewText: I have two of these, one in my 5th wheel trailer and one at home.   When camping one should “never leave home without it”.  This is a great bq for two people.  I have a larger stainless natural gas bq for company but I use the 1200 grill the most.  Love the thermometer that comes from with the grill.  Highly recommend this feature.
Results.Title: Great Outdoor product

Results.ReviewText: I went to a BBQ with some friends in OZ and they had this great little grill they carried there with them. I was so impressed I bought one for us upon our return to SoCal and have absolutely no regrets. Well made, it holds the heat well and it is easy to clean up.
Results.Title: A wonderful little grill
